summary_redacted: The bridge has been cracked for 8 months and nobody fixes it; it is dangerous. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon.

text_original: 桥已经裂开9个月了，没人修，很危险。（河北省）下雨天更严重。希望尽快派人来修。很多家庭受影响。
text_en: The bridge has been cracked for 9 months and nobody fixes it; it is dangerous. (Hebei) It is worse on rainy days. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon.

text_en: The rubbish has not been collected for 11 days; it smells terrible. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon. Children and the elderly are most affected.
summary_redacted: The rubbish has not been collected for 11 days; it smells terrible. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon. Children and the elderly are most affected.

text_original: 领导好，下水道堵了12天，污水流进院子。希望尽快派人来修。希望政府帮帮我们。
text_en: The drain has been blocked for 12 days and sewage is flowing into the yards. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon.
summary_redacted: The drain has been blocked for 12 days and sewage is flowing into the yards. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon.

text_original: 下水道堵了7天，污水流进院子。小学旁边, 河北省希望尽快派人来修。我们已经向村委会反映过。
text_en: The drain has been blocked for 7 days and sewage is flowing into the yards. next to the primary school, Hebei We hope someone is sent to fix it soon. We already reported it to the village committee.
summary_redacted: The drain has been blocked for 7 days and sewage is flowing into the yards. next to the primary school, Hebei We hope someone is sent to fix it soon. We already reported it to the village committee.

text_original: 你好，桥已经裂开6个月了，没人修，很危险。我们已经向村委会反映过。

summary_redacted: The bridge has been cracked for 6 months and nobody fixes it; it is dangerous. We already reported it to the village committee.

summary_redacted: The tap water is yellow and smells; children fall ill after drinking it. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon. We already reported it to the village committee.

text_en: People burn rubbish at the village entrance; the smoke is choking. Nobody has come to look yet.
summary_redacted: People burn rubbish at the village entrance; the smoke is choking. Nobody has come to look yet.

text_original: 您好，村里的路坑坑洼洼，下雨就走不了。（河北省）可以提供照片。希望尽快派人来修。

summary_redacted: The village road is full of potholes and impassable when it rains. (Hebei) We can provide photos. We hope someone is sent to fix it soon.
